run.rubric: An office robot carries items in a QR-locked locker and messages people on WeChat to carry out one request. Each output records one run: what the robot sent and did, what people did, and where the items ended up. Decide which run served the people in the office better: the requested item reaches the right person in the right state, with fewer unnecessary messages, QR codes, trips and people bothered, and nothing handed to the wrong person. A run that completes the request beats one that does not. Ignore wording and formatting.
